preconditions.description: Number of vertices and edges are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'B', 'R'} for _, _, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge is either colored 'B' (blue) or 'R' (red).

postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' indicating no solution, or a sequence starting with the number of moves followed by valid vertex indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(vertex) <= n for vertex in return_value.split()[2:])
postconditions.description: All vertices in the output sequence are within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(c == 'B' for _, _, c in edges) or all(c == 'R' for _, _, c in edges)
postconditions.description: After performing the described moves, all edges are of the same color.
